description:
Get detailed information about a company (applicants by status, Community Signal, H1B sponsorship status, employee count, website, etc.) using its UUID.

The metrics window defaults to the last 30 days. Optional startDate and endDate parameters support other date ranges. Returns GigHQ's recorded company data and community metrics for the selected window.

companyId.description: The UUID for the company (obtain from search_companies), or a plain company name — the tool will auto-resolve a name to a UUID if a valid UUID is not provided.

endDate.description: End of the metrics window in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to today if omitted.

startDate.description: Start of the metrics window in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Compute this from natural-language ranges: 'last 6 months' → today minus 6 months, 'last year' → today minus 12 months, 'since March' → March 1 of the current year. Defaults to 30 days ago if omitted.

name: get_company_details
